estimate_focal_median: estimate camera focal length from 3D points using the median robust estimator method
estimate_focal_weiszfeld: estimate camera focal length from 3D points using the Weiszfeld iterative re-weighted least-squares method
estimate_focal_with_confidence_mask: estimate camera focal length from 3D points filtered by a boolean confidence mask
estimate_focal_with_bounded_range: estimate camera focal length with configurable min and max focal length bounds
review_estimate_focal_knowing_depth: review the estimate_focal_knowing_depth function to understand its reprojection-based focal estimation approach
